scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir .prerender && node scripts/static-routes.mjs
scripts.check: eslint . && tsc --project jsconfig.json --noEmit && prettier --check src content scripts tests *.mjs *.js index.html package.json jsconfig.json README.md
scripts.validate: npm run check && npm run build && npm run test:agents && npm test
scripts.format: prettier --write src content scripts tests *.mjs *.js index.html package.json jsconfig.json README.md
